svg.aria-label: and the aggregate cannot tell the two apart
svg.text: Accuracy and completeness — two mutations of one delivery list
2 // Two of an event's five fields are CLOCKS, which ch01 established:
3 // et = event time, when it happened · pt = processing time, when we saw it
4 // v = the value being summed (also, here, the amount to charge)
5 type Event { id, key, et, pt, v }
6 // primitive: EVENTS — the book's 9 events, in PROCESSING order (tools/stream_seed.js).
7 // EVENTS[4] = (id 4, key "a", et 245, pt 246, v 6) <- the order this chapter charges
8 // primitive: NONE — no value. Distinct from a value of 0.
9 // primitive: WIN — the window width, in seconds of event time. WIN = 120
10 // primitive: CHK — the index whose state was checkpointed before the crash. CHK = 4
11 // primitive: TOTAL — the dataset's true total. TOTAL = 45
12 // primitive: winOf(et) — the START of the window holding et.
14 // primitive: append(xs, x) — xs with x added at the end. append([1], 2) = [1,2]
15 // primitive: contains(xs, x) — is x in xs? contains([1,2], 2) = true
19 // primitive: REPLAYED — the ids re-read after a crash at CHK. REPLAYED = [5, 6, 7, 8]
20 // primitive: REPLAY_V — their combined v. REPLAY_V = 22
22 // primitive: indexOf(e) — e's position in PROCESSING order. indexOf(EVENTS[4]) = 4
24 // function: deliver(mode) — the list of record ids a stage actually receives.
35 for (e in REPLAYED) { out = append(out, e.id) }
40 // function: aggregate(ids) — sum v over a delivery list, counting repeats.
45 for (id in ids) { t = t + EVENTS[id].v }
49 // function: windowCost(id) — what ONE duplicate of that record does to its own
50 // window, as a percentage. The damage is v over the window total.
61 // function: main() — THE CALLER: three delivery guarantees, one dataset.
Step 3/0 — and the aggregate cannot tell the two apart
`aggregate` adds `EVENTS[id].v` for each entry and has no idea whether an id appeared before. 23, 45, 67 — three numbers from one dataset, and the function that produced them is
identical and correct in all three cases.
